name: DeliverAI — Governed AI Ordering Agent
summary: An applied academic MVP that turns unstructured WhatsApp conversations into confirmed, traceable orders through a governed AI agent.
details: Built by a five-person team for the Hyperautomation Architectures course at Escuela Colombiana de Ingeniería Julio Garavito.
Connects WhatsApp Business, n8n, a LangChain agent, Spring Boot REST, PostgreSQL and a React admin UI.
Demonstrates structured order capture, explicit customer confirmation, human escalation and operational controls.
Defined as a functional prototype for a controlled pilot; authentication, full auditability, governed n8n hosting and real-customer validation remain pending.
